questions.title: Temperature Converter
questions.description: Write a Java program that converts a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit. Declare a double variable for the Celsius temperature (use 25.0), calculate the Fahrenheit equivalent using the formula F = (9/5) * C + 32, and display both temperatures.
constraints: Use double data type for temperatures
hints: Be careful with integer division - use 9.0/5.0 not 9/5

questions.title: Circle Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program that calculates the area and circumference of a circle. Use a radius of 5.0 and the constant Math.PI. Display both results with appropriate labels.
constraints: Use Math.PI for the value of pi
hints: For r², you can use radius * radius or Math.pow(radius, 2)

questions.title: Time Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program that converts a given number of seconds (use 9876) into hours, minutes, and remaining seconds. Use integer division and the modulus operator to extract each component.
constraints: Display hours, minutes, and seconds separately

questions.title: Simple Interest Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program that calculates simple interest and the total amount. Use principal = 1000.0, rate = 5.0 (percent), and time = 3 years. Use the formula: Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100. Display the principal, interest, and total amount.
constraints: Use double for all monetary values

examples.output:
Principal: 1000.0
Rate: 5.0%
Time: 3 years
Interest: 150.0
Total Amount: 1150.0

hints: You can use += to add interest to principal

questions.title: Character and Type Casting
questions.description: Write a Java program that demonstrates character operations. Start with the character 'A', print its numeric ASCII value, then print the next 4 letters of the alphabet by adding to the character. Also demonstrate converting an int (66) to its character equivalent.
constraints: Show type casting between char and int

examples.output:
Character: A
ASCII value: 65
Next letters: B C D E
Int 66 as char: B
